summary: Boundless Bio (filer) entered into a merger agreement to acquire Serapha Bio via a reverse-merger structure. In the merger, each share of Serapha common/preferred stock will convert into a number of Boundless Bio common stock shares per the Exchange Ratio; Serapha will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary. Options/exercisable warrants will convert into Boundless Bio options/warrants. The transaction qualifies as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a). No explicit price per share, premium, or deal value was stated. Board recommendation and advisor were not named. The filing also notes bound to close conditions typical for such reorganizations. Watch for regulatory clearance and potential dissenting votes.
